items.title: MAAG
description: An online media outlet built end to end on my own: custom CMS with 8 content types across 51 admin screens, a 15-block editor, and a placement engine where the home page composition is itself editable.
Astro front end, Express.js API on Firebase / Firestore, Stripe subscriptions, Docker → Cloud Run.

items.title: Mentormatic
description: A B2B mentoring and coaching SaaS built with a team of four, in TDD and BDD/Gherkin. Astro SSR, React and Alpine.js over Moleculer microservices.
I designed the access-controlled note sharing system and an in-house Alpine.js lazy-loading layer that the whole team adopted.

items.title: wurkspaces.dev
description: A bilingual (FR / EN) showcase site in Astro, Alpine.js and Tailwind.
GDPR cookie banner built as a reusable Astro module.
